title: Upgrade rsconnect-ts to v0.9.0 and bump Node to 24
description:
It's a massive diff but that's almost entirely generated code/JSON.

-----

## Summary

- Bump `@rstudio/rsconnect-ts` to `^0.9.0` in `connect-publish`. v0.9.0 changed `appId`/`appName`/`taskId` to `string`, so `ConnectPublishResult.id` is now a string and the redundant `.toString()` calls are dropped.
- Move both actions to `node24`. `setup-connect` was on the deprecated `node16` runtime; `connect-publish` was on `node20` and is bumped for consistency.
- Refresh tooling in both packages: `@tsconfig/node24`, `@types/node ^24`, `typescript ^5`, and `engines.node ^24`. tsconfigs pin `lib`/`target` to `es2022` because `ts-standard@12`'s parser predates `es2024`.
- Update CI workflow to `actions/checkout@v6`, `actions/setup-node@v6`, `actions/setup-python@v6` running on Node 24.
- Bump remaining JS/TS deps to latest: `@actions/core` 1.x → `^2.0.3` and `@actions/exec` 1.x → `^2.0.0` (v2 is the ceiling — v3 is ESM-only and would break the ncc-bundled CJS `dist/index.js`); `jest` / `babel-jest` / `@types/jest` 29 → `^30`; `@vercel/ncc` `^0.38.4`; `@babel/*`, `ts-node`, `ansi-styles` to current. Resolves `npm audit` vulnerabilities (2 → 0) in both actions.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm install`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build` clean for both actions
- [x] `npm audit` reports 0 vulnerabilities in both actions
- [x] `setup-connect` `npm test` passes (R/Python integration tests skipped as before)
- [x] `connect-publish` `loadArgs` unit tests pass; deploy tests still gated on a live Connect server (unchanged)
- [ ] CI green on this PR

title: feat: upgrade @rstudio/rsconnect-ts to v0.8.0
description:
I tested this change via an action in a private repository with the following configuration. All worked as expected.

```yml
name: Publish Content to Connect

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Publish some things
        uses: rstudio/actions/connect-publish@de7ded629f69da6e6e61852baf0c9f3ed9616391
        with:
          url: ***
          api-key: ***
          access-type: logged_in
          show-logs: true
          dir: |
            ./quarto-stock-report-python
```
